limits: Representative deep audit, not proof of all third-party project/plugin compatibility.
Structural method inventory includes deprecated methods, abstract vendor methods and separately excluded dependencies; each needs triage before implementation.
All write probes use generated disposable SQLite data. The message_event probe restores an original upgrade column in the fixture.
No fresh PostgreSQL, clean Windows, physical input or full Administration GUI/save matrix in this audit.
Maya/applets and excluded production code are not acceptance targets. Extra database vendors are not proposed.
